title: GroupFile
description: Which workspace crates version together, and what each group owns.

Bookkeeping.description: What is never product work, for any group or planner.

paths.description: Commits touching only these paths count for nothing.

ignore-revs.description:
Commits that count for nothing, by full id: a change whose paths
misattribute it, such as a break scoped to a crate that is gone,
touching a group by one doc line. Kept apart from
[`BLAME_IGNORE_FILE`], which the walk also reads, so `git blame`
still credits the lines to it.

bot-subjects.description: Subject prefixes reserved to the release bot.

version.description:
The group's version, which every member's `[package].version`
projects: bare for a library, with its channel suffix for the app.

internals.description: Crates the group owns and never versions.

tag.description: The group's tag, with `{version}` standing in for its version.

paths.description: Directories the group owns beyond its crates and fixtures.
